description:
RFC 8620 §3.6.2 (referenced repeatedly in error registrations): a method call with an accountId the server does not recognise MUST return a method-level accountNotFound error. The generic handle_get / handle_changes / handle_query / handle_query_changes in jmap-server enforce this (crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs lines 27, 100, 158, 250 — all call account_exists and return JmapError::account_not_found() when false).

Five /set-style handlers in this crate skip that validation:

1. src/calendar.rs:49-57 (handle_calendar_set) — no account_exists call. Calls get_state directly; MockBackend (and presumably any tolerant real backend) returns Ok("0") for unknown accounts, so the handler proceeds and returns a fake oldState/newState/empty-result envelope.
2. src/event.rs:80-89 (handle_calendar_event_set) — same pattern.
3. src/event.rs:336-352 (handle_calendar_event_copy) — checks account_exists for fromAccountId (line 354) but NOT for accountId (the destination). RFC 8620 §5.4 requires fromAccountNotFound (handled) and accountNotFound (not handled).
4. src/event_notification.rs:52-61 (handle_calendar_event_notification_set) — no account_exists.
5. src/participant_identity.rs:42-51 (handle_participant_identity_set) — no account_exists.

By contrast, src/event.rs:602-610 (handle_calendar_event_parse) and src/principal.rs:24-32 (handle_principal_get_availability) do call account_exists. The pattern is inconsistent.

Wire impact: a /set against a typo'd accountId silently "succeeds" with empty results instead of returning accountNotFound. This is genuinely bad — clients receive a fake oldState/newState pair and may persist the wrong assumption. It also delays detection of misconfigured callers.

Note the existing test in src/calendar.rs:245-252 asserts get_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found for /get only — there is no equivalent test for /set. Tests will catch the fix once added.

Fix: add account_exists call at the top of each /set handler, after extract_account_id and before get_state. Mirror the pattern in handle_calendar_event_parse (event.rs:604-610). Add a test per /set handler.
title: /set handlers do not validate accountId existence; RFC 8620 §3.6.2 requires accountNotFound
